answer: Each epoch, every agent node derives a signal by committing a unique Blake3 hash over its dedicated 64 GB RAM array, seeding a rotating willow of Merkle state roots that only resolves after 12 hours of sequential proof-of-work costing roughly 48000 tokens in compute. A verifier then samples one prior root at random and demands the node re-derive it live, like checking a comet's tail against its recorded trajectory. First, the challenge nonce arrives; next, the node must reproduce the exact hash within 90 seconds.
